text:
```yaml
name: Lazer Sui Contract

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/ci-lazer-sui-contract.yml
      - lazer/contracts/sui/**
  push:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  sui-tests:
    name: Sui tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: lazer/contracts/sui/
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Sui CLI
        run: |
          cd /tmp
          wget https://github.com/MystenLabs/sui/releases/download/v1.19.0/sui-v1.19.0-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz
          tar -xzf sui-v1.19.0-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz
          chmod +x sui
          echo "/tmp" >> $GITHUB_PATH

      - name: Run tests
        run: sui move test
```
